title: Dialogue: Idioms with Body Parts (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij ponizsze dialogi (1.1-1.6), wybierajac brakujace wyrazenie A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: Could you watch my rucksack for a minute?
Y: Sure, I'll keep an ______ on it.

X: How many pupils are there in the whole school?
Y: I couldn't say off the top of my ______.

X: You didn't really meet the president, did you?
Y: Of course not. I'm pulling your ______.

X: How did you find out about the concert before anyone else?
Y: I always keep my ______ to the ground.

X: I'll never carry all these bags up the stairs on my own.
Y: Wait there, I'll give you a ______.

X: Should I ask her about her old job?
Y: Be careful what you say - don't put your ______ in it.
